body.p: Posting rule 62 moves amounts between account group 62 and account group 63.
body.note: Back up the ledger database before you change a posting rule, so that you can go back if the rule is wrong.
Only a ledger administrator can change a posting rule, and every change is written to the audit log.
A posting rule takes effect at the start of the next period, not in the period that is open now.
